text:
maya: FYI customer (BlinkHealth) asked to onboard marlin-18b for their summarization pipeline. They care a lot about tail latency < 120ms p95 and want on-prem/private deployment. Can we triage?

ravi: pinging ML infra — size + quant plan? 18B typically fine but depends on KV cache and sequence length. Any target seq len?

lina: they mentioned avg seq=512, spikes to 1024. Suggest run quick perf sweep 512/1024 and 256 to get latency curve. Also need quality eval against their summarization tests.

owen: @ravi @lina adding checklist: 1) reproducible eval dataset from customer (sanitized) 2) fp16 baseline run 3) 4-bit quant (q4_0/q4_k) smoke 4) compare ROUGE/QA and latency 5) regression gating thresholds.

carla: note from prior 18B runs — marlin's attention implementation was friendly to tensor cores but we saw sampling instability with 4-bit quant on long contexts. We'll need to run deterministic sampling and greedy checks.

maya: customer will provide a redacted dataset by EOD. They're ok with a canary private deployment first. Priority: medium-high, since they requested SLA for dedicated later.

ravi: I'll spin up a small experiment on dedicated-test GPUs. Starting with fp16 baseline: 

```bash
# run baseline
python run_infer.py --model marlin-18b --dtype fp16 --seq-length 512 --batch 1 --profile --output ./results/fp16_512.json
```

ravi: plan to follow with q4 runs: q4_0 then q4_k. I'll attach perf numbers when done.

deploy-bot: Job started: perf-sweep-marlin-18b-fp16-512 (job id: jb-7852). ETA ~ 45m. :rocket:

lina: quick reminder: add prompt/eval templates to the eval harness and pin seed. Also log token-level latency and KV hit rates.

owen: I'll prepare canary deployment config. For private, we need KMS + audit logs. @maya can you confirm compliance requirements?

maya: they require SOC2 + retention 90 days and key rotation monthly. I'll share the compliance checklist with you now.

carla: if q4 shows >1.2x degredation in ROUGE compared to fp16, mark for human review. Also include BLEU/QA depending on their metrics.

ravi: noted. Assigning to me for initial perf + quant smoke. Will post numbers here.

maya: thanks — let's reconvene once fp16 baseline done. :white_check_mark:
